name: PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk
summary: PT Bank Sinarmas Tbk provides various banking products and services in Indonesia. The company operates through Marketing and Credit, Treasury, and Trade Finance segments. It offers savings, time and on-call deposits, and current accounts; mutual funds; bancassurance products; and mutual funds investment and guarantees services. The company also provides unsecured, car ownership, multipurpose, working capital, investment loans, as well as simas cash fund, expansion of collateral, back-to-back credit, micro and business credit, and palm oil farmers loan; inward documentary collection, issuance, amendment, advising, outward documentary collection, discount export document, and negotiation expor…
